integrity: The main theorem is analytic. The supplied checker is a deterministic numerical sanity check and is not used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal-weight, single-segment, zero-common-noise Gaussian specialization only; the theorem does not cover arbitrary weights, arbitrary admissible interaction functions, heterogeneous noise, non-Gaussian drivers, or continuous-time suprema.
title: Extreme-particle pinning thresholds for alpha-Wiener mean-field bridges
